digest.component_or_area: quality gate automation (Mypy, Ruff, C901, linting)
propositions: Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be enabled after measuring and revalidating existing diagnostics.
Ruff ASYNC, DTZ, and RUF hygiene rule families must be enforced through approved ratchets after resolving pre-existing violations.
C901 function complexity must be wrapped in a symbol-level shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 and integrated into the canonical lint gate.
All newly-enforced gates must exit 0 against current origin/main, and pre-existing ratchet-family diagnostics present on origin/main must be resolved before corresponding gates land.
Four independent stories must execute in dependency order (d9f5 then 28cd then 125d) for pyproject.toml edits, with 28cd creating and 125d extending the shared Ruff ratchet test file.
Every story change requires LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved Gerrit comments before merging to main.
